name: Safe Mode Transition Guarded Activation
description: When the on-board computer detects a critical fault (b_fault=1), the satellite transitions to safe mode, disabling non-essential payloads. Guarded UPR: power reduction applies only when b_fault=1.

elements.name: Critical Fault Flag
elements.description: Binary flag: 0=nominal operation, 1=critical fault — safe mode required.

uncertainty.source: AcubeSAT on-board software fault management system
uncertainty.option_1: critical fault — safe mode, payload disabled

elements.name: Safe Mode Power Budget
elements.description: Safe mode power budget: minimum subsystems only

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(P) = P_safe if b_fault=1, else P_nominal; guard activates safe mode power reduction when fault detected
consistency_relations.upr_description: Guarded UPR: safe mode power reduction applies only when critical fault flag b_fault=1 is active.
